Filmmaker Imtiaz Ali's daughter Ida Ali gets engaged

Filmmaker Imtiaz Ali announced the engagement of his daughter, Ida Ali, to her longtime boyfriend, Krish Agarwal. Ali shared the news on social media, seeking blessings. Krish Agarwal reportedly works with a hedge fund and has launched his own production company.
